A prop that the type of `$props()` declares and the component never reads is either dead code or a bug: a caller passes it and nothing happens. The rule reports each property of that type that is neither destructured nor read, also properties of nested objects that are read only in part, and an index signature where the destructuring has no rest element.

It needs type information (`parserOptions.project` or `projectService` with `@typescript-eslint/parser` for the scripts of a component), a `$props()` with a type annotation, and Svelte 5 with runes. Without types it reports nothing. A destructuring with a rest element (`...rest`) counts as using everything. The properties come in the order in which TypeScript 6 has them, which is the order of the reports; for the members of a union, and the keys of `Pick`, `Omit` and `Record` over a union, Bun keeps its own order.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`. It uses types where the scripts of a component have `@typescript-eslint/parser` and a project:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";
import ts from "typescript-eslint";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  {
    files: ["**/*.svelte"],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: { parser: ts.parser, projectService: true, extraFileExtensions: [".svelte"] },
    },
    rules: { "svelte/no-unused-props": "error" },
  },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported, `'avatar' is an unused Props property.`:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  interface Props {
    name: string;
    avatar: string;
  }
  let { name }: Props = $props();
</script>

<p>{name}</p>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  interface Props {
    name: string;
    avatar: string;
  }
  let { name, avatar }: Props = $props();
</script>

<img src={avatar} alt={name} />
```

## Options

| Option                        | Default | What it does                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkImportedTypes`          | `false` | Also check properties that are declared outside the component, such as in an imported interface                             |
| `ignoreTypePatterns`          | `[]`    | Skip types whose printed text or name matches: a name to be equal to, or `"/pattern/flags"`. The text is that of TypeScript 6 |
| `ignorePropertyPatterns`      | `[]`    | Skip properties whose name matches, written the same way                                                                    |
| `allowUnusedNestedProperties` | `false` | Count a prop as used when any of it is read, without checking the properties of nested objects                              |
